title: Shared definitions for Franca pack files
description: Definitions that the pack file schemas refer to. The lists of allowed values are the same as the CHECK constraints of the catalogue tables in contracts/db/schema.sql and the reference data in contracts/db/seed.sql. They are compared with those files by the tests in contracts/pack/tests.

item_key.description: language:type:slug, for example nl:lexeme:zakje or nl:grammar:niet-geen. The type is the middle part of the key, and the pack builder maps it onto an item kind by the type of file the item is defined in. A variety or script subtag may follow the language. Lexeme keys follow the rule in server/src/franca/catalogue/item_keys.py. Up to 139 characters, so that a key with a sense or step suffix (#<slug>) stays within the 200 characters that the database allows.

node_key.description: The key of a course node or a lesson, for example nl:unit:a1-u05 or nl:lesson:a1-u05-l03.

slug.description: A short name of lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, unique within its file.

variety.description: A variety code that pack.yaml lists, for example nl-be.

speaker.description: A speaker key that pack.yaml lists.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of a media file, in lowercase hexadecimal. The file itself is in the media store, and its record is in media/.

review_status.description: draft until a native-language reviewer has checked the entry.

upos.description: The Universal Dependencies part of speech.

rights_scope.description: private: only in the owner's own installation. shareable: may be in a pack that is passed on.

licence.description: A licence code from the app's licence list (catalogue_licence in contracts/db/seed.sql).

goal_key.description: A learner goal from the app's list (study_goal in contracts/db/seed.sql).

ui_element.description: An interface element from the app's list (catalogue_ui_element in contracts/db/seed.sql).

error_type.description: An error type from the app's list (catalogue_error_type in contracts/db/seed.sql).

markdown.description: Markdown. It is rendered to sanitised HTML by the pack builder.

bilingual.description: The same text in the target language (tl) and in English (en).

english_first.description: Text in English (en), with the target-language text (tl) where there is one.

example.description: An example sentence with its English translation, and a recording where there is one.

pronunciation.description: How an item is said in one variety. There is a phonemic transcription or a recording by a named speaker, or both.

goals.description: The learner goals the item is meant for, with a weight from 0 (exclusive) to 1. An item with no goals is offered to learners whatever their goals.
